text:
alice: quick heads-up — gptx-2.0-quant landed in model-catalog earlier and we started seeing kv-cache shape errors on runtime v2.14 in canaries. Can we pin runtime on prod until we confirm a runtime fix?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: model-publish gptx-2.0-quant by carol at 2026-03-10T21:12:11Z

bob: confirmed. Canaries show `kv_cache::alloc_size_mismatch` when total_seq > 2048, stack traces attached to canary logs.

carol: quick repro snippet I used:
```
REQUEST: model=gptx-2.0-quant runtime=v2.14
input_len=2200 -> crash: kv_cache assertion
```

dave: proposal: temp pin prod runtime to v2.13 (stable). Keep canaries on v2.14 to gather signals.

alice: +1. @deploy-bot please add runtime pin for prod to pinlist and note reason. low blast radius, short window.

deploy-bot: Pinlist updated: prod-runtime pinned -> v2.13 until 2026-03-12T00:00:00Z by alice. Reason: kv-cache shape mismatch with gptx-2.0-quant on runtime v2.14.

infra-oncall: adding operational notes: rollback window 30m after pin change, will perform warmup and health-check across all prod pools.

bob: QA action: running evallist `kv_cache_regression` across canaries and a small subset of prod (read-only). If metrics stable in 2h, we can consider unpin.

carol: filing release note draft: "Model gptx-2.0-quant requires runtime alignment for long sequence KV caching. Temporary runtime pin applied to production. Runtime patch incoming."

alice: also tagging SRE and support so they can watch customer-facing latency/failure alerts. I'll post an incident-lite note in #incidents if we see degradations. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: runtime-unpin-check at 2026-03-11T02:00:00Z to evaluate canary metrics automatically.

dave: if canaries fail the regression test, we keep the pin and prepare rollback of the model publish. Keep PR #4823 as blocker for unpin.

carol: linking runtime fix PR: https://git.redwood.ai/runtime/pulls/4823 — patch aligns KV cache allocation for variable head dims.

alice: thanks all — pin applied and owners assigned. Keep thread updates short; ping if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
